description: Check up to 25 vendor or supplier domains in one call for ransomware leak-site claims, for third-party-risk reviews. Returns one result per domain (found, claim count, claims with group, dates and sources). Domains only; use lookup_victim for company names. At most 15 claim records are read per batch, so a domain with many matches is marked partial. Every result is an unverified claim from a criminal leak site, not a confirmed breach; found=false is not proof of absence. Read-only; one flat price. Costs $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.
name: batch_exposure_check
